Il voto misura la configurazione tecnica: The grade measures the technical configuration (HTTPS, certificate, headers), not whether the site is phishing or distributes malware: even a scam site can score highly. For reputation use Google Safe Browsing or VirusTotal.
Nessun test di vulnerabilità: vengono le: No vulnerability testing: only the server's public responses are read, as a browser would.
Imposta HSTS con max-age di almeno 31536: Set HSTS with a max-age of at least 31536000, and includeSubDomains if every subdomain uses HTTPS.
Definisci una Content-Security-Policy re: Define a strict Content-Security-Policy: it is the main defence against XSS and content injection.
Imposta X-Frame-Options: DENY o SAMEORIG: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN, or frame-ancestors in the CSP, against clickjacking.
Imposta X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff,: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, so the browser does not guess file types.
Disattiva con Permissions-Policy le funz: Use a Permissions-Policy to switch off unused browser features (camera, geolocation…).
Valuta Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-: Consider Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin to isolate the window from other sites.
